The '''Enclave''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spaceport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kile II]]. It was destroyed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Assault on Kile II]].<ref name="RS" />
